pr41.body:
## Why

The beta_1_3 policy requires 128 checks, but 86 numbered A assertions have no recovered per-ID definition or producer. This PR traces their provenance and restores useful source-bound component evidence without inventing mappings or promoting unexecuted acceptance.

## Historical findings

- Compared PR #23 `4d3d2ec`, #35 `b7e4f18`, #39 `aaa1330d`: identical 128 required IDs / 63 applicable hard gates / 21 automatic owners / 86 undefined A IDs / 21 external checks.
- Searched 393 reachable commits, saved refs and matching text histories; inspected policy introduction `c499d4c` and numbering `11ee241`, PR discussions, issue matches and prior-context leads. No original per-ID definition was recovered. The search scope and limitations are preserved in `docs/evidence/validation-recovery-20261010/`.
- Located original Signature, private IR metadata/integrity and benchmark tests. The old Hartke/Marshall automatic-resolution/fallback route was deliberately removed by 1.3 commit `4c7688d`; restoring it wholesale would conflict with the current product. A5–A8 remain BLOCKED pending original definitions and explicit scope reconciliation.

## Changes

- Preserve all 86 IDs with original assertion/process/producer unconfirmed; store historical evidence and investigation leads.
- Generate a 128-row JSON/CSV inventory beside the actual consolidated gate: 21 CI automatic / 86 definition missing / 13 external-input processing / 7 manual or target-environment / 1 composite release acceptance.
- Add 13 independent calculator contracts from the surviving original equations and thresholds; retain the original three fixture scenarios.
- Fix a reproduced numeric-input bug: JSON booleans were accepted as measurements because Python bool subclasses int. Reject them; numeric formulas and thresholds are unchanged.
- Execute calculator contracts on clean HEAD and preserve commit/tree, command, exit code, per-case outcomes and SHA-256-bound logs. Missing assertions/cases, skipped/duplicate/failed cases, dirty/stale source and mismatched CI identity fail closed.
- Upload separate `Chimera-recovered-component-evidence` in build validation. `policy_claims=[]`; component PASS cannot satisfy any undefined A, real-DI, listening, reference or DAW acceptance.

## Validation and status

Exact verified GitHub source: `07dbfa5b0da24ae7a6000ad6dc215ba2aea67c46`, tree `8a97f134eb264b7a214eb17e04222b3bf9ad6b3a`. Re-executed all 12 relevant test/contract scripts on its clean checkout: all exit 0, including 92 unittest cases (13 calculator, 11 recovery, 26 consolidator, 21 publisher 1.3, 11 publisher 1.2 and 10 publisher 1.1.2) plus retained procedural suites. The real recovered-evidence CLI also exited 0 and wrote source/tree/input/log hashes, 13 passing per-case results, `policy_claims=[]` and `release_verdict=BLOCKED`. Local SHA-256 verification of every output succeeded. Native product/installer/CAB results are not claimed from these Python tests.

Fresh [Product run 38057692032](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38057692032) and [Windows Candidate run 38057692124](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38057692124) were queued when inspected; no product CI PASS is claimed. The separate recovered-component artifact will be generated by validation-contract when the runner executes.

Production-policy consolidator fixtures remain **21 PASS / 107 BLOCKED** and the publisher rejects the BLOCKED verdict. This is a fixture result, not a fresh product CI count. `release-policy.json`, `ci-check-map.json`, waivers and signature benchmark policy are byte-for-byte unchanged. `release_approved=false`.

Remaining inputs: original 86 numbered definitions/ownership and IR scope decision; real guitar/bass DI and reference/capture provenance; listening, Studio One/Windows host lifecycle, 30-minute soak, controlled hardware timing, B14 review and final-source Product/Candidate/CAB evidence. Full audit: `docs/VALIDATION_RECOVERY_1_3.md`.

Stacked on #39. No merge, publication, website change, waiver or approval.
